cases.name: hc-heart-rate-record-three-samples
cases.note: Pattern (a): a record of three samples gives three Observations; each carries its sample identity and the record id as the group.

cases.name: hc-heart-rate-decimal-double
cases.note: A value that is not exactly representable (72.1) is hashed through its shortest round-trip text (assumption A49).

cases.name: hc-heart-rate-null-offsets-use-the-phone-zone
cases.note: A record with no zone offsets: the phone's zone at that instant (here Asia/Kolkata, +05:30).

cases.name: hc-heart-rate-recorded-offset-is-used-as-given
cases.note: The recorded offset wins over the phone's zone (a record written in Tokyo, read in Los Angeles).

cases.name: hc-heart-rate-utc-offset-z-is-plus-zero
cases.note: An offset of Z is written +00:00, never Z.

cases.name: hc-heart-rate-manual-entry-is-user-entered
cases.note: MANUAL_ENTRY carries the user-entered tag (assumption A46).

cases.name: hc-heart-rate-artifact-and-late
cases.note: An implausible value from a record delivered days later: both quality flags, in code order.

cases.name: hc-heart-rate-no-device-reference
cases.note: Without a device reference there is no device element.

cases.name: hc-resting-heart-rate-instant
cases.note: An instant record: effectiveDateTime at the record's own offset.

cases.name: hc-hrv-rmssd-own-code
cases.note: RMSSD has no LOINC code: the project's metric system, code hrv-rmssd, display in code.text; never SDNN.

cases.name: hc-sleep-session-stages
cases.note: Each mapped stage is one duration Observation; awake in bed maps to awake; out of bed and unknown give none (A43).

cases.name: hc-sleep-session-null-offsets
cases.note: Sleep with no offsets uses the phone's zone for each end.

cases.name: hc-hydration-record
cases.note: A hydration record is dietaryWater in mL, identified by its record id.

cases.name: hc-nutrition-full-record-with-meal
cases.note: One record, seven mapped nutrients, one Observation each, all sharing one group value; the meal is a separate category entry; unmapped nutrients change nothing; the window is a period (A47).

cases.name: hc-nutrition-no-meal
cases.note: Meal type 0 (unknown): no meal entry, never an invented one.

cases.name: hc-nutrition-unlisted-meal-code-is-other
cases.note: A meal code the contract does not know is other.

cases.name: hc-nutrition-missing-nutrient-is-absent-not-zero
cases.note: A nutrient the record does not carry gets no Observation (a missing nutrient is not zero).

cases.name: hc-nutrition-zero-sodium-is-stored
cases.note: Zero is a valid intake: stored, and part of the content key.

cases.name: hc-nutrition-from-a-wearable-is-not-user-entered
cases.note: An automatically recorded nutrition record carries no user-entered tag.
